description: Land Title Settlement Department - Heraliyawala, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420369 (23/0405)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
